I will correct them': 'Scene' actor Naslen asks audiences to decide if he should stick to Malayalam cinema 
 TOI Entertainment Desk / etimes.in / Updated: Oct 26, 2026, 14:02 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium

 Print Naslen. Actor Naslen is stepping into Tamil cinema for the first time with Suriya's ‘Scene’, an upcoming action-comedy that brings together several familiar names from the Malayalam film industry. The actor has asked audiences to watch the film before deciding whether he should continue working exclusively in Malayalam. Speaking at a promotional event in Dubai, Naslen described the project as a special milestone in his career and invited viewers to share their honest opinions after its theatrical release. “This is my first Tamil film, and it is very special. After watching the film, you, the audience, should tell me whether I should stick to Malayalam cinema alone. Watch the film on November 6 and share your opinions. If there are any mistakes, please point them out. I will correct them. I play a slightly different character in this film. I hope to continue receiving everyone’s love,” Naslen said, as quoted by Asianet News. Watch From Chiranjeevi to Prabhas, South cinema’s first quarter shows shift from scale to storytelling Naslen makes his Tamil debut with a villainous role
 Known for his work in Malayalam cinema, Naslen takes on a different screen persona in ‘Scene’. The actor plays a villain, which was show in the recently unveiled glimpse. ‘Scene’ features Nazriya Nazim as the female lead. Anand Raj, Lal and Raj Priyan also appear in important roles Filmmaker Jithu Madhavan, who gained recognition for directing the Malayalam films ‘Romancham’ and ‘Aavesham’, is making his Tamil directorial debut with ‘Scene’. The soundtrack is composed by Malayalam music director Sushin Shyam. ‘Scene’ marks his first Tamil film as a composer. Suriya targets another hit with ‘Scene’
 Actor and producer Suriya is backing the action-comedy entertainer. After the success of ‘Karuppu’ and ‘Vishwanath and Sons’, he is looking to score another hit with this project. Mounted on a large scale, ‘Scene’ brings together a cast and crew with strong Malayalam cinema connections. The film is scheduled to arrive in theatres on November 6. Poll Vote & Share your view
